newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybeans end up on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybeans end up on institutional support.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended sharply up on Tuesday on institutional support, traders said.
The key January 1997 contract ended at 3,230 yuan ($389) per tonne, rising 120 yuan. It opened at an intra-day high of 3,240 and a low of 3,110.
March rose 20 to 3,130, May 20 to 3,140, July 40 to 3,200, September 160 to 3,410 and November 30 to 3,380.
Combined volume fell to 28,500 tonnes from 72,100.
Traders said institutional buying was responsible for today's rises but further rises are unlikely in the short term.
